bookings.subtitle: Customers build a cart of services, pay through our secure escrow system, and you get notified immediately. Pricing, scheduling, and payouts are handled for you.

bookings.feature3Desc: Set a flat rate or charge per hour, and the app handles the maths for you.

faq.label: Questions
faq.title: Everything you need to know.
faq.a1: LifeKit is one place to discover services, connect with people, join communities and explore opportunities. You can book local services, offer your own skills, swap skills with others and join communities, with Gracy, our guide, to help you find your way.
faq.a2: Joining is free. Providers pay a small commission only on completed paid bookings: 3% during your first 90 days, then 8%. Optional paid plans unlock extra tools.
faq.a3: Clients pay into a secure LifeKit wallet. The money is held until the job is completed and confirmed, then released to you. You can withdraw your earnings through Stripe.
faq.a4: Skill Swap lets you trade services without money — for example, photography sessions for accounting help. Both sides agree on what they’ll deliver.
faq.a5: Card payments are processed by Stripe, and we never see your full card number. Payments are held until both sides confirm, and if something goes wrong you can open a dispute for our team to review.
faq.q6: When can I download the app?
faq.a6: The LifeKit app for iPhone and Android is coming soon. Providers can sign up on this website today — join the waitlist below to be told the moment the app is live.
faq.a7: English, Georgian and Russian, with more on the way.

intro.label: About LifeKit
intro.title: Everything you need. Nothing you don't.
intro.text: LifeKit brings the services, people, communities and opportunities you need into one connected platform. Whether you're settling into a new place or simply navigating everyday life, LifeKit helps you find what you need and connect with the right people.

gracy.label: Your guide
gracy.title: Meet Gracy. Your guide to LifeKit.
gracy.text: Need help finding something? Gracy helps you navigate LifeKit, discover relevant services and explore useful resources.
gracy.note: Gracy is still learning, and she'll keep getting more helpful as LifeKit grows.
gracy.bubble: Hi! What are you looking for today? I can point you to services, communities and places on LifeKit.

trust.label: Trust & safety
trust.title: How we keep LifeKit fair.
trust.intro: LifeKit is a growing community and we're building trust features step by step. Here's how things work today.
trust.i1Desc: Our team can review service listings and remove any that break our rules. After each completed booking, clients rate the provider, so you can see how others found them.
trust.i2Desc: We're working on provider identity checks. Until verification is live, a listing on LifeKit doesn't confirm a provider's identity or qualifications, so check their reviews and message them before you book.
trust.i3Desc: Once a booking is completed, the client and the provider can each rate the other from 1 to 5 stars and add a comment.
trust.i4Desc: You can report a person or content in the app, or block someone so they can't contact you. Our team looks at reports and can remove content or suspend accounts.
trust.i5Title: How complaints and disputes are handled
trust.i5Desc: If a booking goes wrong, either side can report an issue from the booking. Payment stays on hold while our team looks at what happened and decides whether to refund the client or pay the provider.
trust.disclaimer: LifeKit is a platform that connects people. We can't guarantee the quality of every service or the outcome of every booking, but we take every report seriously and will look into problems you raise.
